title: One glorification and one worship of the Trinity
english: There is one glorification of Father and Son and Holy Spirit, and one worship. For when the seraphim glorify God, crying “Holy, holy, holy” (Isaiah 6:3), they glorify Father and Son and Holy Spirit.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
Single-paragraph fragment witness (Khazarzar one-page PDF); open-only, no rem sections.
orientation: Epiphanius of Cyprus opens the fragment by stating the single glorification and worship shared by Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, then supports it from the seraphim's threefold cry.
